registration.regulation: ICAO Annex 7 §4.2.2 & LuftVZO Anlage 1 (Abschnitt II): fuselage registration at least 30 cm (0.30 m) high, upright Roman block capitals, width 2/3 height, stroke 1/6 height, hyphen between nationality mark D and 4-letter registration ECJB
